scripts.dev: npm run build -w demiurge && npm run generate:routes && npm run dev -w examples/basic-blog
scripts.build: npm run build -w demiurge && npm run generate:routes && npm run typecheck:consumers && npm run build:examples
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w examples/basic-blog && npm run build -w examples/ssr-page && npm run build -w examples/node-server && npm run build -w examples/static-export
